groups.name: Real routes
groups.note: Route map on real streets, water and 3D buildings. Name two places or give it a GPX file.

items.name: Tower Bridge to St Paul's
items.does: A 1.4 mile walk through real London
items.key: The last street completes, the pin lands and the real trip time punches
items.cmd: /animate-route-map Tower Bridge to St Paul's Cathedral, walking

items.name: Millennium Park to Navy Pier
items.does: A 1.8 mile drive along the Chicago lakefront
items.key: The last street completes, the pin lands and the real trip time punches
items.cmd: /animate-route-map Millennium Park to Navy Pier, Chicago

items.name: Palace of Fine Arts to the Wharf
items.does: A 2.2 mile bike ride along the San Francisco bay
items.key: The last street completes, the pin lands and the real trip time punches
items.cmd: /animate-route-map Palace of Fine Arts to Fisherman's Wharf, by bike

items.name: Head to head
items.does: Two options compared row by row, ending on one payoff stat
items.key: The final bar and winner tick land

items.name: Before and after
items.does: A handle wipes a website from its old design to its new one
items.key: The last product card lands

items.name: Ranking bars
items.does: Bars race through changing years with one hero to follow
items.key: The final year and result land

items.name: Money stat
items.does: One huge counter climbs a chart past its turning point
items.key: The exact final number punches

items.name: Notification stack
items.does: Orders flood a lock screen while the total counts up
items.key: The final order lands and the total slams

items.name: Post receipt
items.does: A social post with racing counts and quote replies
items.key: The red underline finishes

items.name: Headline highlight
items.does: A newspaper flies in and a highlighter marks the evidence
items.key: The highlighter stroke ends

items.name: Evidence desk
items.does: Papers on a desk with a figure circled in red
items.key: The circle closes on the figure

items.name: Day card
items.does: A huge day counter stamps through a calendar
items.key: The final number is circled

items.name: Screen zoom
items.does: The cursor leads the camera to one button, and it clicks
items.key: The button turns to Published

items.name: App launch
items.does: A studio phone receives a transaction and completes it
items.key: The transfer reaches its exact amount

items.name: Laptop reveal
items.does: A laptop opens, wakes on your product and scrolls it
items.key: The product name stamps into place

items.name: Apple one-take
items.does: A dot morphs through a button, a planner and a phone in one take
items.key: The red full stop lands

items.name: Frosted glass
items.does: A glass search bar docks above results and picks one
items.key: The highlight seats on the chosen row

items.name: Exploded teardown
items.does: A product opens into labelled layers
items.key: All five layers lock beside their labels

items.name: Isometric flow
items.does: A 3D diorama of a three-step process
items.key: The van arrives and the last step checks off

items.name: 3D timeline
items.does: A moving rail passes oversized milestone cards
items.key: The playhead stops at the final milestone

items.name: Globe arcs
items.does: Routes cross a dotted globe while a figure counts up
items.key: The last route touches down

items.name: Route map
items.does: A route draws through a pale 3D city, fictional or real, with live trip stats
items.key: The pin lands and the final time punches

items.name: Pencil to blueprint
items.does: A graphite sketch becomes a white-on-blue technical drawing
items.key: Both measurements stamp

items.name: Blue editorial
items.does: An ultramarine cover with frame-filling italic words
items.key: The last word peaks and the underline strikes

items.name: Swiss grid
items.does: A black circle and red field in a strict Swiss grid
items.key: The third phrase settles

items.name: Magazine layout
items.does: A painted image, a serif headline and a real text column
items.key: The handwritten underline finishes

items.name: Risograph
items.does: A two-ink poster prints in stepped passes
items.key: The ink plates snap into register

items.name: Ink wash
items.does: Mountains, a red sun and a small boat on rice paper
items.key: The boat reaches open water

items.name: Glow orb
items.does: A soft breathing orb above one line of type
items.key: The closing phrase lands on the breath

items.name: Retro CRT
items.does: A beam opens into a huge phosphor title with a terminal line
items.key: The status lands and the title snaps tall

items.name: Oscilloscope
items.does: A green signal folds through figures and writes your words
items.key: The last letter lands

groups.name: Claude Code

items.name: Terminal run
items.does: A session plays out from one prompt to a finished result
items.key: The mascot lands on the green result slab

items.name: Agent fan out
items.does: One prompt splits into six subagents, each with its own mascot
items.key: The last agent finishes and they pile onto the result

items.name: Agent loop
items.does: The mascot laps Plan, Act and Check until the tests pass
items.key: Check turns green and the ring cracks open

items.name: Test sweep
items.does: A wall of failing tests flips green in a wave
items.key: The last test lands on the exact total

items.name: Bug hunt
items.does: The mascot surfs a scrolling file until it finds the bug
items.key: The line locks and the lens slams up

items.name: File tree
items.does: A codebase grows branch by branch behind the mascot
items.key: The tree pulls back and the file count lands

items.name: Diff reveal
items.does: The mascot eats the red lines of a real-looking diff
items.key: The last gulp and the final removed count

items.name: Hours collapse
items.does: A full day of hour blocks gets stomped into minutes
items.key: The new time slams in over the old one

items.name: Cost receipt
items.does: A till receipt prints line items for a session
items.key: The total is stamped on the receipt

items.name: Benchmark takeover
items.does: The mascot rides a huge row into a serious leaderboard
items.key: The row seats and #1 stamps

groups.note: These use Claude Code's look, the Claude logo and its pixel mascot. They run on sample content until you tell Claude what to show, and you can turn the mascot or logo off.
